subtasks.title: Cap shift summaries to the last 8 hours; whereIntegerInRaw; tries=2
subtasks.approach: In BuildShiftSummary::forShift, clamp the UTC read window to max(started_at, ended_at-8h) and use that window for CH counts, GPS, and the PG zone CTE. Replace Hit::whereIn('scan_id') with whereIntegerInRaw. Set SendEndOfShiftSummary::$tries = 2. DTO keeps the real shift timestamps. Tests: 17-day shift excludes scans older than 8h; 70k scan ids via whereIntegerInRaw do not HY000; job tries is 2; existing CTE pin still holds.
subtasks.intended_diffs: BuildShiftSummary: SUMMARY_WINDOW_HOURS=8 + summaryWindow() + whereIntegerInRaw. Job: tries 5→2. Tests: 8h clamp, pathological ids, tries pin.

excluded_sites.reason: loadZonePolygonsForMap already uses ANY(?::int[]) on zone ids (bounded).
